items.name: LineRanges
items.summary: Extension trait for [`str`] that provides methods for working with ranges of lines.

methods.name: bom_start_offset
methods.summary: Computes the start position of the file contents: either the first byte, or the byte after the BOM.

methods.name: contains_line_break
methods.summary: Returns true if the text of `range` contains any line break.

methods.name: full_line_end
methods.summary: Computes the offset that is right after the newline character that ends `offset`'s line.

methods.name: full_line_range
methods.summary: Computes the range of this `offset`s line.

methods.name: full_line_str
methods.summary: Returns the text of the `offset`'s line.

methods.name: full_lines_range
methods.summary: Computes the range of all lines that this `range` covers.

methods.name: full_lines_str
methods.summary: Returns the text of all lines that include `range`.

methods.name: is_at_start_of_line
methods.summary: Returns `true` if `offset` is at the start of a line.

methods.name: line_end
methods.summary: Computes the offset that is right before the newline character that ends `offset`'s line.

methods.name: line_range
methods.summary: Computes the range of this `offset`s line ending before the newline character.

methods.name: line_start
methods.summary: Computes the start position of the line of `offset`.

methods.name: line_str
methods.summary: Returns the text of the `offset`'s line.

methods.name: lines_range
methods.summary: Computes the range of all lines that this `range` covers.

methods.name: lines_str
methods.summary: Returns the text of all lines that include `range`.
